items.item: Load More Tips remains unresolved on ten active hubs
items.detail: The 126 current static cards are covered, but hidden results behind Load More are not claimed. Basketball pagination probes did not advance the inventory. This dashboard is therefore a fullest supportable static capture, not exhaustive dynamic OLBG coverage.
items.source_name: OLBG global tips and sport hubs

items.detail: Stale NHL, NBA, EuroLeague/EuroCup, tennis, snooker, volleyball, cricket and greyhound entries are excluded from the active desk. Three still-visible but expired NBA cards (534839, 535674, 534893) are logged rather than published as upcoming picks.

items.item: Official supplements separated from OLBG-discovered rows
items.detail: Forty official-only supplements (12 NHL, 10 NBA, five EuroLeague, eight rugby union, three SHL and two MLB) carry 'official supplementary' provenance and no OLBG link. The dashboard never presents them as proof of OLBG coverage.

items.item: 14 NBA totals blank; all NBA picks capped Medium
items.detail: Moneyline and spread use completed official 2025-26 records. Current totals are not inferred from unavailable current PF/PA inputs, and off-season roster uncertainty caps every NBA selection at Medium.

Rows lacking precise official fixture confirmation or comparable current strength inputs retain blank winner, handicap, total and pick cells. Official review links are not mislabeled as proof of verification.

items.item: Relative OLBG labels retained without UTC inference
items.detail: Today/Tomorrow labels and viewer-timezone renders are preserved as raw card text. ISO date/time fields are used only where official pages independently establish them.

items.item: Six Nations OLBG 14 March label vs official 13 March finish
items.detail: The official 2027 schedule concludes with Ireland–France on 13 March at 20:10 GMT. OLBG's 14 March 20:00 label is retained as raw text and not treated as an official fixture date.

items.item: Four OLBG labels differ from official tournament starts
items.detail: Official sources confirm Bermuda, Senior Italian Open and Stella Artois beginning 22 October, and Stifel beginning 23 October. Later OLBG labels are preserved but flagged as potentially later rounds rather than overwritten.

items.item: F1 race time corrected; standings remain tied to stored capture
items.detail: Formula 1's official US GP page gives 25 October at 16:00 track time. Stored standings inputs are explicitly dated 2026-10-21 and are not described as newly refreshed on 22 October.

items.item: PlusLiga URL redirected to TAURON Liga
items.detail: Three Polish PlusLiga cards remain official confirmation pending. A redirect to a different competition's shell is not accepted as fixture or ratings verification.

ACB officially confirms the final date but its schedule does not pre-confirm participants. The pairing and start label remain OLBG-sourced and unlined; no third-party report is used as official proof.

items.item: Four eligible hubs display no tips
items.detail: Their category pages remain present with zero rows so the empty checks are visible; no substitute fixtures are invented.

items.item: Correct routes and futures IDs enforced
items.detail: Basketball uses sport ID 4 and Golf 5. Rugby League maps State of Origin 2695857, Super League 2801554 and NRL 2801600; the previous State of Origin/NRL swap is removed.

items.item: HOU @ SAS at Moody Center has no home-court adjustment
items.detail: San Antonio remains the official designated home team, but the official Austin neutral venue is shown and the NBA model's home-court logit adjustment is set to zero for this game.
High requires p > 0.70 and fair American odds from -250 through +10000 inclusive. Stronger favourites shorter than -250 are capped Medium and expose the failed price-band gate in matches.json.
